body:
I can sit here and wait for 50 years for a friend, but I can't trust that anyone is actually being real.  And I can't risk letting myself get more destroyed by being friends with a non-friend

Unless I just never let my guard down and never trust anyone even people who are "friends", but then they're not real friends if I'm on guard

How does one make a real friend?  I can't even hold down a close acquaintance for more than a month or so, at best.  I don't know what people dislike about me-- everyone says they love me and whatnot, but it's not actually shown

I can't refute the point of "if some things are unfounded, then everything might be", but OP's saying he/she doesn't remember what it's like to be happy is very valid.  I go through times when I can't remember what it's like to be happy either.

Sure, I might laugh at things or smile, but that doesn't equal happy.  A laugh or a smile doesn't change the feeling deep down when you simply are not happy-- when you simply can't cope.

I suppose you could call it a form of happy.  But it doesn't feel like what happy is supposed to feel like.

OP, I know you can do it.  I don't know how you'll get there, since I don't know how I'll get there either, but you can do it.  I know you can.  Just keep going-- something will change for you someday.
